title: Cornelius was generous.
paragraphs:
Cornelius was generous.
Respected.
Prayerful.
By every human standard, he was already a good man.
Yet heaven still sent a message to him.
Why?
Because being good isn’t the same as knowing God personally.

Sometimes the next step with God isn’t fixing what’s bad.
It’s surrendering what already looks good.
Have you ever felt that quiet nudge for more?

He gave.
He prayed.
People respected him.
But heaven still said his name.
Good wasn’t the end of his story.
Sometimes God calls people who already look like they’re doing everything right.
Cornelius is one of the most surprising people in the Bible.

He wasn’t corrupt.
He wasn’t rebellious.
He wasn’t running from God.
He was already doing good.
And still… God reached out to him.
Because faith isn’t just about being a good person.
It’s about responding when God calls your name next.

Some people stop at “good enough.”
Others stay open to the next step.

Being a good person is important.
But Cornelius shows that God sometimes calls people who already look like they’re doing everything right.
What do you think that means today?
